title: MANDATORY: Plan Before Code
summary: NEVER write or modify source code until a plan has been presented AND explicitly approved by the user. User describing a feature is a QUESTION, not an order to implement. Must present WHERE/HOW/WHAT options first, wait for explicit approval (e.g., 'làm đi', 'triển khai'), then implement.

references.description: User repeatedly frustrated by premature implementation without plan approval
